acceleration_pedal: In case of a critical failure in the steering angle sensor, the system must default to a fail-safe mode, limiting accrelaration and disabling advanced functions if necessary
wheel_steering_angle: In case of steering angle failures, the system must ensure the retention of emergency manual steering control
wheel_speed: The system must periodically verify the calibration of each wheel speed sensor and recalibrate if necessary
yaw_rate: Yaw rate control must be fully integrated with vehicle stability control systems to manage understeer or oversteer situations
steering_torque: The system must adjust steering sensitivity in real-time, steering angle, and driver input
acceleration_pedal&wheel_steering_angle: Lane Change Warning systems must warn the driver of unsafe lane-changing maneuvers based on abrupt changes in acceleration pedal position in conjunction with steering angle deviations

responses.requirement: The vehicle control system must respond to driver input from the accelerator pedal within a specified timeframe to ensure timely throttle actuation
